capabilities: Move completed to-do items under a completed-area heading
Toggle task completion via a sidebar icon, command, or hotkey (Control+Enter by default)
Set the completed area's heading level from h1 to h6
Set the completed area's header name
Turn the sidebar icon off and use a command instead
extras: Author warns the plugin may contain bugs and that more features are in development; includes a Buy Me a Coffee donation link; a Chinese (简) readme version is also available.
problem: Completed to-do items stay mixed in with active tasks, cluttering the task list in a note.
summary: Task-completion utility that moves completed to-do items in the active note under a configurable completed-area heading.
